messages.text: Hey! Quick question, what time do you guys open tomorrow? I'm thinking of swinging by for a cappuccino.

Could you please specify which day you are referring to? Our hours are Monday through Thursday from 07:00 to 18:00, Friday from 07:00 to 20:00, and Saturday from 08:00 to 16:00. If you are unsure of the schedule, I can have the owner follow up with the exact opening time.
Okay, thanks for the full schedule! What time does the shop open tomorrow? I'm hoping to stop by for banana bread.

Could you please specify which day you are referring to? I can provide the opening hours for that day, which are Monday through Thursday from 07:00 to 18:00, Friday from 07:00 to 20:00, and Saturday from 08:00 to 16:00. If you are unsure of the schedule, I can have the owner follow up.
I was hoping to swing by tomorrow, Tuesday. What time do you guys open?
On Tuesday, the cafe is open from 07:00 to 18:00. We would be happy to serve you banana bread during those hours.
